The '''Ikon system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] that was the location of an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] outpost established in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].

It consisted of a [[Red dwarf/Legends|red dwarf]] star named [[Ikon]] and an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]], and as of the months following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] was being patrolled by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]] arranged for a [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] to be supplied to the Rebel forces located there.<ref name="roc" />
